records.normalizedEnglish: The author declines to prove telepathy and calls it established, comparing it to X-rays and wireless telegraphy. No named study, controlled data or evidence sufficient to establish the claim is supplied.
records.originalRussian: Я не желаю отнимать у васъ время, доказывая вамъ существованіе телепатіи.

records.normalizedEnglish: Thought is said to emit spatial vibrations; directed intent is compared to a bullet versus shot, ripples from stones and telegraphy. These are analogies and author theory, not a measured mechanism or instructions to use firearms or throw stones.

The author invokes unnamed practitioners, years of practice, unusual lifestyles and promised secrecy. He limits the chapter to attracting attention for everyday influence, even beyond a hundred versts. No quantified training timetable or verified distance performance is supplied.

Persistently think about wanting another person to take interest in you and assume they do; the author contrasts diffuse with directed alleged impulses. This is historical attempted influence, not consent or demonstrated remote communication.

The author recommends concentration exercises from the manual for best results while allowing alleged results without them, asserting tenfold amplification. He introduces an upcoming business conversation and a wish to establish rapport beforehand; the scenario continues79. No scored prerequisite, timer or ten-stage progression is supplied.
